name: Alfheim
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the start of your turn to look at the top 3 cards in any one explore deck or the relic deck. Place the cards back in any order.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: "Calling it a computer misses the scale." - Admiral Jairdan MosVale
flavourText: Stable, sub-surface geothermal energy on this planet is harnessed for one of the largest computational data-hubs in the galaxy.
